what: Round border of the ”See details” button — on hover a dark line is drawn clockwise from 12 o’clock over a pale base ring in 1.2s, and the arrow inside the ring slides out to the right while fading, then re-enters from the left and settles (same 1.2s). The text beside it shifts the 6px gap on its right to the left, so it is pushed 6px in one go (width unchanged). On hover-out the line rewinds along the same curve

options.--fx-dur: Duration the ring is drawn (via style), default 1.2s
options.--fx-pass: Time the arrow takes to slip out and return (via style), default 1.2s — curve cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1)
options.--fx-track: Pale background ring color (via style), default var(--kf-accent-soft)
options.--fx-ink: Drawn line color (set via style), default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-shift: Neighbor letter shift (via style), default 6px — as in the original, the right gap moves to the left with no transition
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Ring svg (child) — two circles, the front a base ring and the back a drawing line. A circle with r 31.5 (64px box) fits stroke-dasharray 200 (original value) to the circumference
options.--fx-len: Line length (set via style), default 200 — set equal to the circle’s pathLength (the knot 250px ring is 782, as in the original)

use: →View details
note: CSS only. On touch devices (no hover) nothing is drawn and only the base ring is shown

from.where: shared.css .kw-btn — original .c-btn svg circle stroke-dashoffset 200→0 1.2s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) · :before arrow moveX 1.2s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1) · span padding-left 6px

shared.css .kn-circle (original c-button__circle — 250px ring, on hover the line draws from 12 o’clock, dashoffset 782→0 1.6s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)): --fx-dur 1.6s · --fx-ease · --fx-len 782 (circle pathLength 782) · ring only, no arrow or side text

index.html round slide buttons .mo-slidenav (70px white circle) — on hover the brown ring draws a full turn with stroke-dasharray 0 → 214 over .35s cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1), and the arrow slips out to the right and re-enters from the left over .5s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.07,1)
from.options: style="--fx-dur: .35s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1)" — Arrow pass-over is .5s (in the original, the perimeter and arrow lengths differ)
